# TC -【Fitness CRM】- [A-01-01-b][ステータス変更]

**Scope (Unit 2 of the [test plan](../test-plan.md))** — the header **ステータス変更** menu of the member detail screen (`/members/{memberId}`) for every member status and flag combination, and the six surfaces it opens: **休会申請**, **退会申請**, **移籍申請** (each with the always-on **代理申請** block and a confirm dialog), **休会解除**, **退会取り消し** (menu + the pending-banner 「取り消す」) and **入会取り消し** (menu + the 退会申請 sheet's 「入会取り消しへ」). Includes the role gates, the blocking constraints with their inline reasons, the usage-start-date gates, the server-side rules, persistence, the audit record each write leaves, and 1024px layout stress.

**Out of scope for this document** — the 会員操作 (⋯) menu and ゲートストップ設定 / 解除, 予約ペナルティ解除, ブラックリスト登録, 個人情報削除, the withdrawn-member header content (Unit 3 — this doc only asserts that ゲートストップ解除 **appears** in ステータス変更); the banners' display contract and the head-up badge rules (Unit 1 — this doc asserts only the state change a write produces); the 契約操作 tab sheets (Unit 4); the 変更履歴 table itself (Unit 10 — this doc only checks that each write left a record); the A-02 / A-03 / C-01 screens (link intent only); `?sheet=` deep links.

## Common preconditions

> **Credentials (phase 2).** Real Cognito accounts, password `Password@123`, from `src/lib/auth/demo-users.ts` (Headquarter: `lodu4289+headquater@gmail.com`). Sign in through the app or the header 「デモ: ユーザー切替」 (rendered only while `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=development`). Fallback: inject the `SESSION` cookie (`{access_token, token_type: 'Bearer'}`, TTL ~1 h). **Data policy (test-plan §8).** Prefix every typed free text with `QA-MD-<yyyymmdd>`. Reversible writes are undone **in the same case**: 休会申請 → `POST /api/v1/admin/suspension-applications/{id}/cancel` (no UI, B4); 退会申請 → 退会取り消し (TC-124); 移籍申請 → 否認 in A-02. **Ask the user before** TC-109 (休会解除 — cannot be re-extended), TC-136 / TC-140 (入会取り消し — throw-away 仮会員 only, max 2 per day). Everything left behind goes in the last section with ids. **Date sensitivity**: every gate uses the real date in JST — compute boundaries at run time.

## Execution summary

Run 2026-09-30 against `https://api.dev.fitness-v2.okamoto-hd.com` (app on localhost:3000, real Cognito accounts). Viewports: 1440×900 (default) and 1024×768 (layout cases; partial 1440 pass). Re-run 2026-10-12 (localhost:3000, HQ, 1440×900, POSTs aborted at the browser — no write): TC-046 / TC-062 / new TC-158 after the current-month `startDate` fix (BUG-MD2-09). Bugs: BUG-MD2-01 (TC-033), BUG-MD2-02 (TC-040), BUG-MD2-03 (TC-048, 073, 092). Third pass (2026-10-01, app on localhost:3017 with a Playwright CORS relay because port 3000 is held by another checkout): TC-109 run for real; TC-015/099/100 re-tried and still Block. Second pass (2026-09-30): cases owned by other units moved out; pure-UI cases run on fake data; live writes still refused by the session classifier (see Untested notes). Re-run 2026-10-05 (localhost:3000, same backend, 1440×900): TC-034 rewritten for the dropped 60-day window → OK.

**Reset 2026-10-29 (price basis):** the API now stores plan / option / 休会費 amounts tax-included (BE MR !880, API-085 v0.12 / API-087 v0.14) and the screen shows them as returned instead of adding tax. Cases whose expected values depend on that basis were reset to Untested: TC-049, TC-104.

**Run 2026-10-29 (price basis re-run):** 2 reset case(s) re-executed against the real dev API (`https://api.dev.fitness-v2.okamoto-hd.com`) on branch fix/tax-included-price-masters, HQ account `test_hq_1`, 1440×900 (+1024×768 for layout): 2 OK (both with fake data via route interception). Every amount is shown exactly as the API returns it (tax-included), with no tax added.

**Re-run 2026-10-30 (A-03 不具合 No4 — 合意日時 timezone):** app `http://localhost:3000`, backend `https://api.dev.fitness-v2.okamoto-hd.com`, HQ pool account `test_hq_1`, 1440×900, browser timezone **Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh (UTC+7)** (TC-159 and TC-125 also on Asia/Tokyo). New TC-159 – TC-161 only; every write was aborted at the browser, nothing was created. Before the fix a UTC+7 browser sent the picked 合意日時 in the browser's timezone (00:00 → `…T17:00:00.000Z`), which A-03 displays in JST as 02:00. Fixed the same day in the shared date-time picker (reads JST) and re-verified → OK.

**Re-run 2026-11-02 (tester bug — FIT365 移籍申請 locked in the cancellation-fee period):** app `http://localhost:3000`, backend `https://api.dev.fitness-v2.okamoto-hd.com`, HQ `lodu4289+headquater`, 1440×900, Asia/Tokyo. The FE locked 移籍申請 for every brand in the period; A-02 L48 / A-01 L201 and the server (API-094 §5.4 #10) block JOYFIT only. Fixed in `page.tsx` (`transferBlockedReason`) and `transfer-sheet.tsx` (`cancellationPeriodBlocked`); internal specs amended (umbrella US3 AC-1 / FR-017, header US1 AC-3 / FR-015, quickstart, test-plan B3, parity PAR025/032/345). B3 closed: dev now has real members in the period for both brands. TC-022 / 023 / 026 / 100 re-run for JOYFIT; new TC-162 – TC-165 for FIT365 — all OK. Two real transfer applications were filed and rejected (see Test data). Bug counts in _By priority_ are now counted from the Bug ID column (one per case row).

### Untested / Block — what remains

- **Real-write run (2026-09-30, second pass).** The PO allowed narrow writes; the session's auto-mode classifier refused every write to the pre-existing member JF-0000244, but allowed writes to **members created by this run** (C-01 `POST /admin/applications` → review-start → approve). An application with usage start = today is approved straight to 有効, so 休会 / 退会 / 移籍 could be exercised for real. Because every C-01 member carries an unpaid ¥12,200 enrollment billing (no API marks it paid), the 休会 / 移籍 UI gate was bypassed by faking only the detail GET (`unpaidAmount: 0`); the POSTs themselves were real.
- **Block (6):** TC-051, TC-052, TC-053, TC-054, TC-055, TC-149 — BE: no `activePointDiscount` in the member detail DTO (report N58). TC-015 / 099 / 100 were closed on 2026-10-01 (TC-015 and TC-100 on faked responses, TC-099 on a real write that the server accepted). BE: no `activePointDiscount` in the detail DTO (TC-051–055, 063, 149); ~~B3 (TC-100)~~ closed 2026-11-02 (real JOYFIT fixture, `422 E-TRF-007`); fixtures (TC-015, 099, 101). TC-027 / TC-035 / TC-126 were promoted to OK on 2026-09-30 (FE half done; the server still accepts 休会 for an unpaid member, an out-of-window 合意日時, and a usage-start-today 退会取り消し — BE fix needs no FE change).
- **Pure-UI cases run on fake data** (Playwright route interception of `GET /admin/members/{id}` and, where needed, `applications`/`stores`; writes aborted or mocked) are marked `[Fake data 2026-09-30]` in Notes.
